type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n S : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        0 < S →
          ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
            (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
            (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
                  ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace n S x y start rows answer S).clock - start) ≤
                    4 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑S
